spots.name: Mount Hayes
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 4,216 m (13,833 ft).

spots.name: Denali Hwy.: Tangle Lakes to Maclaren Summit
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 126 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L2216639.

spots.name: Kevita Pond Viewpoint
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint facing north. Side light at either end of the day. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.name: Maclaren River Viewpoint
